description: This Java class `OrderReadHelper` is a utility helper for extracting and computing various pieces of information related to an Order entity within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods to access order details, address info, financial totals, status, roles, and related entities like products and contact mechanisms, as well as calculations for shipping, taxes, and other attributes of an order.

classes.name: OrderReadHelper
classes.description: A utility class for accessing and calculating details related to an Order within the OFBiz framework.
